steps.description: AC-1/AC-9: Verify canonical `.cursor/remote.json` exists in active and template copies with aligned shape and placeholders.
AC-2: Verify schema guidance defines required fields, optional fields, data types, and allowed enums.
AC-3: Verify at least two safe target examples are documented (local docker-like and remote VM/SSH-like).
AC-4/AC-6: Verify mode-aware validation is fail-fast only when `REMOTE_EXECUTION=1` and skipped when `REMOTE_EXECUTION=0`.
AC-5: Verify actionable remote validation error format includes path, expected rule, actual value/type, and fix hint.
AC-7: Verify security guidance prohibits committed secrets and requires env-var references for sensitive values.
AC-8: Verify README and runbook both document remote setup, mode behavior, and troubleshooting.
Negative-path coverage: missing config, malformed JSON, invalid field/enum/value, and secret-like inline value guidance is present and test-checked.
